thread:
alex: deploy-bot stopped the release due to failing integration tests in staging. CI job 128 failed during migration test. blocking the 13:00 change window.
marta: saw it too. test failing on `test_migration_idempotent` --- looks like migrations aren't idempotent when run in parallel. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/128/logs
ryan: logs attached show SQL deadlock followed by timeout. runner output:
```
E       sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.errors.DeadlockDetected) deadlock detected
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
FAILED tests/integration/test_migrations.py::test_migration_idempotent - TimeoutError
```
release-manager: this is during the final canary gate, right? if it's a genuine migration race, we should probably pin previous db-schema to avoid data risk.
alex: yes, canary preflight hit it. uncertain if it's test infra flakiness or migration code. infra-sre any DB maintenance or high load?
infra-sre: no maintenance. saw a brief spike in connections at 12:38 UTC correlated with concurrent migration runner starts. Might be our test concurrency exposing race.
marta: options: 1) pin to last-green release (safe, closes change window) 2) try one quick rerun with migration concurrency set to 1 (slower but might pass) 3) block and investigate (delays window).
ryan: prefer quick rerun with concurrency=1 to validate whether it's infra/test harness. If passes, we can proceed and then follow up w/ a migration hardening ticket. If it fails consistently, pin.
release-manager: how long will a rerun take? we have 15m left in window.
ryan: rerun about ~7m if we scale down concurrency. I'll kick it now.
deploy-bot: deploy paused due to test failure. Manual promote allowed for user: release-manager. Audit id: db-20260323-618001.
alex: thanks. started rerun with `CI_MIGRATION_PARALLEL=1` at 12:45 UTC.
ryan: rerun logs show migration completed but another test flaked (fixture timeout). snippet:
```
INFO: migration step 4 applied
WARNING: retrying transaction due to serialization failure
pytest runtime: 6m 12s
FAILED tests/integration/test_feature_x.py::test_end_to_end - FixtureTimeout
```
marta: that looks like unrelated flake. rerun didn't hit the same migration deadlock. Can we consider this a pass for migration stability?
release-manager: product cares about the window. recommendation: mark canary as pass for migration-related checks, proceed with promo, but open a follow-up to triage the fixture flake and add stricter migration idempotency tests. Approve manual promote?
infra-sre: agree to proceed. but please tag release with `temp-pin-db-schema` if you decide to pin; otherwise record manual promote reason.
alex: not pinning. we will promote, but putting a short hold: roll out to 10% then monitor db tx errors for 30m. if errors reappear, rollback to previous tag.
release-manager: agreed. I'll perform manual promote and annotate the release notes: "Canary passed after concurrency-limited rerun; fixture flake observed separately. Monitoring window 30m."
deploy-bot: manual promote initiated by release-manager at 12:53 UTC. Canary rollout to 10% started.
ryan: monitor dashboards. watching pg error rates and migration logs.
marta: opening ticket MIG-342: "investigate migration idempotency & fixture stability" and adding logs/trace.
infra-sre: pg error rate stable so far. no deadlock spikes.
release-manager: summary: rerun with lowered migration concurrency avoided deadlock; decided not to pin but to limit initial canary to 10% and triage follow-up. If deadlocks resume, we'll rollback. Posting notes to release doc and notifying stakeholders.
alex: thanks all. moving follow-up to MIG-342 and #postmortems. Closing thread unless new failures show. :white_check_mark:
